p: a city that was conquered by … siege,
a city that was conquered by an army laying siege,
They do not have time to pour … libations, … they have time to engage in intercourse,
They do not have time to pour wine for libations, as their passion for idolatry is not pressing at that time, but they have time to engage in intercourse,
Jewish craftsmen to whom a gentile sent a barrel of wine
to say … Give us its monetary value … once it has entered into their possession,
to say to him: Give us its monetary value instead. But once it has entered into their possession,
permitted for a person to say to a gentile:
Go and placate … the governmental tax
Go and placate the collectors of the governmental tax
A person may not say to a gentile: Go in my stead to the commissary [la’otzer]
Rav said to him: … You say
Go in my stead to the commissary?

w.7: Go in … stead to the commissary
w.13: Go in … stead to the commissary

p: who sells his wine to a gentile,
Ameimar says: The legal act of acquiring an object by pulling
as those Persians send gifts [pardashnei] to one another and do not retract them,
does not acquire … in … a gentile,
does not acquire it in a transaction involving a gentile,
that they do not retract their … because they are taken over by haughtiness,
that they do not retract their gifts is not due to the halakhot of acquisition but because they are taken over by haughtiness,

w.29: their … because they are taken over by

g: שהרי אותם פרסים שולחים מתנות זה לזה ולא חוזרים בהם

p: From where do I say that … from
From where do I say that acquisition by pulling does not apply to gentiles? It is from
which Rav said to certain wine shopkeepers:
When you measure wine for gentiles,
dinars from them and then measure … for them.
dinars from them and then measure the wine for them.
And if they do not have dinars with them … lend them
And if they do not have dinars with them readily available, lend them
so that it will be a loan
As if you do not do so,
when it becomes wine … a libation it becomes … in your possession, … and when you take … payment for wine
when it becomes wine used for a libation it becomes so in your possession, and when you take the money it will be payment for wine
And if it enters your mind
